shortDefinition.en: A third-party collection of suggested camera settings centered on a Film Simulation and complementary image-rendering controls.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 第三方围绕胶片模拟及互补图像呈现控制提出的一组相机设置建议。

en: A recipe name is not a guarantee of film equivalence or compatibility with every camera generation; the complete settings and intended camera matter.
zh-cn: 配方名称不保证与胶片等效，也不保证兼容所有相机代际；完整设置和适用机型很重要。

example.en: A recipe may combine Film Simulation, white-balance shift, tone curve, color, and grain; verify each option on the intended camera.
example.zh-cn: 配方可能组合胶片模拟、白平衡偏移、影调曲线、色彩和颗粒；应在适用机型上核查每项。

sources.title: Fujifilm X-Trans V Recipes — Fuji X Weekly
sources.locator: Compatibility statement and community recipe directory
sources.supports: Third-party recipes organized by stated camera generation and model, not universal interchangeability.
